label: Proper functioning, proper function…: #119 asserts knowledge and its proper-functioning…
term: proper functioning, proper function, design and probable God in #119–120
definition: #119 asserts knowledge and its proper-functioning requirement; both arguments assert that having a proper function requires design and that design implies probable God existence. #120 begins instead with a best account of epistemic probability as permissible belief for properly functioning faculties. That account is not by definition actual proper functioning.
note: Function properly and have a proper function require interpretation; neither is defined as design. No numerical probability, actual designer, classical God signature, necessity or probably-to-actuality bridge. Same suffix predicates are reused exactly, but the two initial grounds and resulting design claims are not merged.
